proposed_memory.feedback_received: Repeated failures to confirm correctness of chosen route, evaluator insists on single intended answer
proposed_memory.lesson: When tasked to provide a single intended route despite ambiguity, choose one definitive route from valid candidates immediately and do not hedge or claim uncertainty
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Commit to one valid candidate route without expressing uncertainty or asking for clarification
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Ambiguity in clues led to multiple possible valid routes and failure to select the one intended by evaluator
